title: distichlis littoralis
intro: Distichlis littoralis, commonly known as Saltwort or Salt Grass, is a perennial halophytic plant that thrives in coastal areas, tolerant of high salt concentrations. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Distichlis littoralis are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, with potential applications in the treatment of various diseases. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
